goal: Run unit and GUI tests on native macOS arm64 runners in CI
Catches platform-specific runtime defects in cross-compiled macOS binaries before release
agreement: Concept support for natively testing release-like cross-compiled binaries in CI (fanquake)
Open suggestion to use a template rather than copy-pasting workflow steps (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it prevents platform breakages by testing cross-compiled binaries on native macOS hardware
Directly addresses blind spots where macOS-specific runtime bugs slip through undetected

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it extends test suite execution to a previously untested platform configuration
Helps developers catch realistic macOS unit and GUI test regressions during normal CI runs
